name: @Emitter
designer: MUST show it as an input component (no input flow, one `__default__` output flow).
runtime: MUST obtain it through `ComponentManager.findMapper(plugin, name, version, config)`, call `create()` on the mapper and drive the `Input` (RUN-024).

name: @PartitionMapper
designer: MUST show it as an input component; if `stoppable`, MUST render the extra options `$maxRecords` and `$maxDurationMs` returned in the component properties (default -1 = unlimited).
runtime: MUST call `assess()`, `split(desiredSize)` on the coordinator side and `create()` per split on the worker side; MUST treat `isStream()` as streaming mode.

name: @Assessor
runtime: MUST call `Mapper.assess()` on a started mapper and use the value to compute the split size; the unit is component-defined (bytes by convention).

name: @Split
runtime: MUST call `Mapper.split(desiredSize)` and create one `Input` per returned Mapper (sequentially or in parallel); returned mappers are Serializable and MAY be shipped to workers.

name: @PartitionSize
runtime: MUST pass the value it wants to `split(long)`; for `int` parameters the runtime narrows with `intValue()`.

name: @Producer
runtime: MUST loop `Input.next()` until it returns null (batch) or until the stop strategy / external stop (streaming); MUST call `Input.start()` before and `Input.stop()` after.

name: BufferizedProducerSupport
runtime: none

name: @Processor
designer: MUST render one input connection per input flow and one output connection per output flow returned by the server.
runtime: MUST create it with `ComponentManager.findProcessor(...)`, call `start()`, then per group `beforeGroup()`, `onNext(...)` per record, `afterGroup(...)`, finally `stop()`.

name: @ElementListener
runtime: MUST feed each record through `Processor.onNext(InputFactory, OutputFactory)`; InputFactory.read(name) returns the current record of that input branch (null if none).

name: @BeforeGroup
runtime: MUST call `Processor.beforeGroup()` before the first `onNext` of each group.

name: @AfterGroup
runtime: MUST call `Processor.afterGroup(OutputFactory)` (or `afterGroup(OutputFactory, boolean last)` when `isLastGroupUsed()`) at group end and at end of data (flush); MUST route emitted records like `onNext` outputs.

name: @LastGroup
runtime: MUST call `afterGroup(output, last)` when `Processor.isLastGroupUsed()` is true, with `last=true` exactly on the final flush.

name: @Input
designer: MUST create one input connection per distinct name (`ComponentDetail.inputFlows`) and label them.
runtime: MUST return, in `InputFactory.read(name)`, the record for that branch.

name: @Output
designer: MUST create one output connection per branch (`ComponentDetail.outputFlows`); connection named `REJECT` is the reject connection.
runtime: MUST provide an `OutputFactory` whose `create(name)` returns an emitter for every name; unknown/unconnected branches MUST NOT fail (discard).

name: OutputEmitter
runtime: MUST implement it in `OutputFactory.create(name)`; MUST convert non-Record values.

name: MultiOutputIterator
designer: SHOULD display all branches listed in `@Output(branches)`.
runtime: MAY implement `createMultiOutputIterator()`; if not implemented, components using it fail at runtime (Beam reference does not).

name: TaggedOutput
runtime: MAY interpret `FLOW` as `__default__` if MultiOutputIterator is implemented.

name: Named branches (__default__, REJECT)
designer: MUST expose one connection per name in `inputFlows`/`outputFlows`; SHOULD style `REJECT` differently.
runtime: MUST route by exact branch name; job edges default to `__default__` (`Job.from(id)` / `to(id)`).

name: Output component (sink)
designer: MUST treat a processor with empty `outputFlows` as a terminal component (no outgoing connection allowed).
runtime: MUST run it as the last stage; it MUST still get `beforeGroup/afterGroup` calls and a final flush.

name: Combiner (not supported)
runtime: none

name: @DriverRunner
designer: MUST show it without connections; SHOULD allow it in a job as an independent step/trigger target.
runtime: MUST obtain it with `ComponentManager.findDriverRunner(plugin, name, version, config)`, call `start()`, `runAtDriver()`, `stop()` on the coordinator; it MUST NOT handle records.

name: @RunAtDriver
runtime: MUST invoke `DriverRunner.runAtDriver()` exactly once per execution, inside the plugin classloader (TCCL) - `DriverRunnerImpl` handles it.

name: Component lifecycle hooks (@PostConstruct / @PreDestroy)
runtime: MUST call `start()` before use and `stop()` in a finally block, on every component instance including every split Input; MUST NOT reuse a stopped instance.

name: Runtime wrapper interfaces (Lifecycle, Mapper, Input, Processor, DriverRunner)
runtime: MUST code the host engine against these interfaces (they are the only stable surface with the manager).

name: Component instantiation (ComponentManager.find*)
designer: MUST persist the component `version` together with each saved configuration (ComponentDetail.version at design time).
runtime: MUST pass the persisted version so migration runs; MUST handle empty Optional as 'component missing'.

name: Batch grouping and maxBatchSize
designer: MUST render `$maxBatchSize` (it is delivered as a normal property) and send its value back in the flat configuration.
runtime: MUST apply `$maxBatchSize` as an upper bound of the group size (default 1 in the local runner when absent) and MUST always flush at end of data.

name: Streaming input (infinite mapper)
designer: SHOULD flag `mapper::infinite=true` components as streaming (job never ends unless stop conditions are set).
runtime: MUST treat `Mapper.isStream()` as unbounded; MUST provide a way to stop (call `Input.stop()` or set stop conditions).

name: Streaming stop conditions ($maxRecords, $maxDurationMs)
designer: MUST render the two options for stoppable inputs (they are ordinary properties).
runtime: MUST honour them by passing the flat properties to `findMapper`; the framework enforces them in `StreamingInputImpl`.

name: Streaming retry strategy
runtime: SHOULD expose these keys through its LocalConfiguration implementation (family-prefixed keys `<family>.<key>` are tried first).

name: @Checkpoint
designer: SHOULD hide checkpoint properties from the normal form (they are state), or show them in the `CHECKPOINT` form type.
runtime: MUST persist the state emitted by RUN-031/RUN-033 and MUST re-inject it as `$checkpoint.*` at restart; only when `talend.checkpoint.enabled=true`.

name: @CheckpointData
runtime: MUST call `Input.getCheckpoint()` only when `isCheckpointReady()` is true (or via the callback) and MUST serialize the state.

name: @CheckpointAvailable
runtime: MUST poll `Input.isCheckpointReady()` after `next()` (explicit mode) or supply a callback to `Input.start(Consumer<CheckpointState>)` (automatic mode).

name: Checkpoint runtime protocol ($checkpoint, CheckpointState)
runtime: MUST implement persistence/restore of the JSON above; MUST migrate the state when `__version` is older (the framework's nested migration applies to the checkpoint type).

name: @ConditionalOutput
designer: MAY call `type=available_output` (ACT-014) with the current configuration to filter `outputFlows`.
runtime: none

name: @ReturnVariables / @ReturnVariable
designer: MAY expose the variables to downstream expressions (Studio-like host).
runtime: none

name: @AfterVariables / @AfterVariable / @AfterVariableContainer
runtime: MAY call the container method after the component finished.

name: optionalRow
designer: MAY relax the requirement of an outgoing connection for such inputs.
runtime: none

name: Serialization requirements
runtime: MUST ship the plugin to every worker and register it before deserializing; MUST set the whitelist in secured deployments; MUST use `ContainerFinder.Instance.set(...)` when the default finder cannot see plugins.

name: Internal configuration keys ($-prefix)
designer: MUST send them under the same prefix as the other properties of the component configuration root.
runtime: MUST forward them unchanged to `findMapper`/`findProcessor`.

name: Flat configuration to constructor arguments
designer: MUST serialize form values into these exact key shapes using each property's `path` from ComponentDetail.
runtime: MUST pass the full map (including defaults) to the manager; MUST surface the validation IllegalArgumentException as user error.

name: Job DSL and local runner
designer: MAY use `family://name?...` URIs as a portable job serialization for tests.
runtime: MAY reuse the Job API as a reference or embedded engine; a custom engine MUST reproduce the semantics (levels, branch wiring, flush). SHOULD be compared against for acceptance tests: the same chain must give the same output in the host.

name: Beam translation of a job
runtime: Reference for an engine adapter: MUST reproduce branch filtering/mapping, key-based multi-input join and group semantics on the target engine.

name: Beam I/O adapters (TalendIO, TalendFn)
runtime: MAY reuse these classes; if embedded, MUST have `component-runtime-beam` and Beam on the container parent classloader (see `BeamCustomizer` class index).

name: Beam coders and schema registry
runtime: A distributed host MUST guarantee that the schema id resolves on the decoding side.

name: Component validation at registration (ModelVisitor)
runtime: A host registering plugins through ComponentManager gets this for free; a host with its own scanner MUST replicate these rules.

name: Runtime Mode (UNSAFE)
runtime: MAY set UNSAFE in production once plugins have been validated at build time.

name: Input and output flows (FlowsFactory)
designer: MUST use `inputFlows` / `outputFlows` of ComponentDetail to build connectors.
runtime: MUST honour the same names when wiring branches.

name: Processor input conversion and group buffer
runtime: MUST call `beforeGroup()` before the first `onNext` (it initializes reflection state and the buffer) - `onNext` before `beforeGroup` fails with NullPointerException on `parameterBuilderProcess`.

name: Multi-input record grouping (GroupKeyProvider)
designer: MAY let users configure the join key per input.
runtime: MUST provide a join strategy for multi-input processors.
